input.sql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency='CZK' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency='EUR' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS diff
FROM yearmonth ym JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212
